description:
A 3-winding transformer.

The model uses an equivalent star model with a star (hidden) bus. The user must transform the data to use `CW = CZ = CM = 1` and `COD1 = COD2 = COD3 = 0` (no voltage control) if taken from a PSS/E 3W transformer model. Three equivalent impedances (connecting each side to the star bus) are required to define the model. Shunt conductance (iron losses) and magnetizing susceptance can be considered from the star bus to ground. The model is described in Chapter 3.6 in J.D. Glover, M.S. Sarma and T. Overbye: Power Systems Analysis and Design.

id.description: Unique integer identifier for this component.

name.description: Name of the component. Components of the same type (e.g., `PowerLoad`) must have unique names, but components of different types (e.g., `PowerLoad` and `ACBus`) can have the same name.

available.description: Indicator of whether the component is connected and online (`true`) or disconnected, offline, or down (`false`). Unavailable components are excluded during simulations.

primary_star_arc.description: An Arc defining this transformer `from` a primary bus `to` the star bus.

secondary_star_arc.description: An Arc defining this transformer `from` a secondary bus `to` the star bus.

tertiary_star_arc.description: An Arc defining this transformer `from` a tertiary bus `to` the star bus.

star_bus.description: Star (hidden) Bus that this component (equivalent model) is connected to.

active_power_flow_primary.description: Initial condition of active power flow through the transformer primary side to star (hidden) bus. Units: MW.

reactive_power_flow_primary.description: Initial condition of reactive power flow through the transformer primary side to star (hidden) bus. Units: MVAr.

active_power_flow_secondary.description: Initial condition of active power flow through the transformer secondary side to star (hidden) bus. Units: MW.

reactive_power_flow_secondary.description: Initial condition of reactive power flow through the transformer secondary side to star (hidden) bus. Units: MVAr.

active_power_flow_tertiary.description: Initial condition of active power flow through the transformer tertiary side to star (hidden) bus. Units: MW.

reactive_power_flow_tertiary.description: Initial condition of reactive power flow through the transformer tertiary side to star (hidden) bus. Units: MVAr.

r_primary.description: Equivalent resistance from primary to star (hidden) bus. Per-unit on system base. Units: pu.

x_primary.description: Equivalent reactance from primary to star (hidden) bus. Per-unit on system base. Units: pu.

r_secondary.description: Equivalent resistance from secondary to star (hidden) bus. Per-unit on system base. Units: pu.

x_secondary.description: Equivalent reactance from secondary to star (hidden) bus. Per-unit on system base. Units: pu.

r_tertiary.description: Equivalent resistance from tertiary to star (hidden) bus. Per-unit on system base. Units: pu.

x_tertiary.description: Equivalent reactance from tertiary to star (hidden) bus. Per-unit on system base. Units: pu.

rating.description: Thermal rating. Flow through the transformer must be between -`rating` and `rating`. in psy5 a required param with an option to be nothing Units: MVA.

r_12.description: Measured resistance from primary to secondary windings (R1-2 with CZ = 1 in PSS/E). Per-unit on system base. Units: pu.

x_12.description: Measured reactance from primary to secondary windings (X1-2 with CZ = 1 in PSS/E). Per-unit on system base. Units: pu.

r_23.description: Measured resistance from secondary to tertiary windings (R2-3 with CZ = 1 in PSS/E). Per-unit on system base. Units: pu.

x_23.description: Measured reactance from secondary to tertiary windings (X2-3 with CZ = 1 in PSS/E). Per-unit on system base. Units: pu.

r_13.description: Measured resistance from primary to tertiary windings (R1-3 with CZ = 1 in PSS/E). Per-unit on system base. Units: pu.

x_13.description: Measured reactance from primary to tertiary windings (X1-3 with CZ = 1 in PSS/E). Per-unit on system base. Units: pu.

base_power_12.description: Base power for per unitization for primary-secondary windings. Units: MVA.

base_power_23.description: Base power for per unitization for secondary-tertiary windings. Units: MVA.

base_power_13.description: Base power for per unitization for primary-tertiary windings. Units: MVA.

base_voltage_primary.description: Primary base voltage. default of get_base_voltage(get_from(primary_star_arc))) Units: kV.

base_voltage_secondary.description: Secondary base voltage. default of get_base_voltage(get_from(secondary_star_arc))) Units: kV.

base_voltage_tertiary.description: Tertiary base voltage. default of get_base_voltage(get_from(tertiary_star_arc))) Units: kV.

g.description: Shunt conductance from star (hidden) bus to ground (MAG1 in PSS/E). Per-unit on system base. Units: pu.

b.description: Shunt susceptance from star (hidden) bus to ground (MAG2 in PSS/E). Per-unit on system base. Units: pu.

primary_turns_ratio.description: Primary side off-nominal turns ratio with respect to connected primary bus (WINDV1 with CW = 1 in PSS/E).

secondary_turns_ratio.description: Secondary side off-nominal turns ratio with respect to connected secondary bus (WINDV2 with CW = 1 in PSS/E).

tertiary_turns_ratio.description: Tertiary side off-nominal turns ratio with respect to connected tertiary bus (WINDV3 with CW = 1 in PSS/E).

available_primary.description: Status if primary winding is available or not.

available_secondary.description: Status if secondary winding is available or not.

available_tertiary.description: Status if tertiary winding is available or not.

rating_primary.description: Rating for primary winding. Units: MVA.

rating_secondary.description: Rating for secondary winding. Units: MVA.

rating_tertiary.description: Rating for tertiary winding. Units: MVA.

primary_group_number.description: Vector group number ('clock number') indicating fixed phase shift between the `from` and `to` buses due to the connection group configuration.

secondary_group_number.description: Vector group number ('clock number') indicating fixed phase shift between the `from` and `to` buses due to the connection group configuration.

tertiary_group_number.description: Vector group number ('clock number') indicating fixed phase shift between the `from` and `to` buses due to the connection group configuration.

control_objective_primary.description: Control objective for the tap changer for winding 1.

control_objective_secondary.description: Control objective for the tap changer for winding 2.

control_objective_tertiary.description: Control objective for the tap changer for winding 3.
